title: Howden PRO SX Series | Cooling Tower Fans
description: Howden Pro SX Series cooling tower fans are touted to be so quiet that other noise-reduction methods are not necessary. Cooling Tower parts from ICST.

layout.title: Howden PRO SX Series | Cooling Tower Fans

paragraphs: The Howden Pro SX Series cooling tower fans are often much quieter than standard cooling fans. Howden touts this fan to be so quiet that other noise-reduction methods such as sound attenuating walls and water silencers are not necessary.

bullets.text: Damps mechanical vibration: the FRP blades offer vibration damping and good chemical resistance.
Frees up space – the SX offers the opportunity to build a compact installation, occupying less space and reducing materials costs
Simple to assemble and adaptable for a range of applications
Enhances cooling capacity – you can increase fan speed to produce more air at noise levels which are still acceptable
Applications – Field-erected cooling towers, packaged cooling towers, air-cooled condensers (ACC), air cooled heat exchangers (ACHE) and ventilation systems
